{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hesperidium Wing''' was located in the [[Valorum Center]]&mdash;a judicial psychiatric unit where most of the patients were only a danger to themselves.

It was there where [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] was held in isolation for three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before finally being rescued by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Bardan Jusik]], [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] and [[Kal Skirata]].
